saved_plan.plan:
**5‑Day Intermediate Muscle‑Gain Split**  
*(Full‑Gym Equipment – Bench, Barbell, Cable, Machines, Dumbbells, Pull‑up bar, etc.)*  

---

### General Warm‑Up (All Days)  
- **5–10 min** light cardio (treadmill jog, rowing, or bike)  
- **Dynamic mobility** (arm circles, leg swings, hip circles, band pull‑apart)  
- **Warm‑up sets** for the first exercise of the day: 2 light sets (50 % of working weight) before moving to working sets.  

### Safety Reminder (All Days)  
- **Form first** – never sacrifice technique for weight.  
- **Use a spotter** on heavy lifts (bench press, squat, overhead press).  
- **Progressive overload** – add weight only when you can complete all reps with good form.  
- **Rest** 60–90 sec between sets for hypertrophy; 2–3 min for heavy compound lifts.  
- **Hydrate & listen** – if you feel sharp pain or extreme fatigue, stop and reassess.  

---

## Day 1 – Chest & Triceps  
| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bench Press | 4 | 8–10 | Heavy compound; keep feet flat, back slightly arched. |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 | 10–12 | Target upper chest; elbows at ~45°. |
| Cable Fly (or Pec Deck) | 3 | 12–15 | Full stretch at bottom, squeeze at top. |
| Dips (weighted if possible) | 3 | 8–10 | Lean forward to hit chest; keep knees bent if too hard. |
| Triceps Pushdown (rope) | 3 | 10–12 | Full extension; avoid flaring elbows. |
| Overhead Triceps Extension (cable) | 3 | 12–15 | Keep elbows tucked; full range. |

---

## Day 2 – Back & Biceps  
| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Deadlift | 4 | 6–8 | Heavy; focus on hip hinge, keep back neutral. |
| Pull‑ups (weighted if possible) | 3 | 8–10 | Full range; use assisted machine if needed. |
| Bent‑Over Barbell Row | 3 | 10–12 | Keep torso parallel, pull to lower ribs. |
| Seated Cable Row | 3 | 12–15 | Squeeze shoulder blades together. |
| Face‑Pulls | 3 | 15–20 | Great for rear delts & rotator cuff health. |
| EZ‑Bar Curl | 3 | 10–12 | Keep elbows stationary; full contraction at top. |
| Hammer Curl | 3 | 12–15 | Neutral grip; focus on forearm engagement. |

---

## Day 3 – Legs (Quad‑Focused)  
| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Back Squat | 4 | 6–8 | Heavy; maintain depth below parallel. |
| Front Squat | 3 | 8–10 | Emphasizes quads; keep elbows high. |
| Leg Press | 3 | 10–12 | Push through mid‑foot; avoid locking knees. |
| Walking Lunges (dumbbells) | 3 | 12–15 per leg | Keep torso upright; 90° knee bend. |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 12–15 | Slow eccentric, pause at bottom. |
| Standing Calf Raise | 4 | 15–20 | Full stretch at bottom, full contraction at top. |

---

## Day 4 – Shoulders & Traps  
| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Overhead Press (Barbell) | 4 | 6–8 | Keep core tight, avoid arching. |

**One‑Week Grocery List for an Active Adult (Balanced, Healthy, and Versatile)**  
*(Quantities are approximate; adjust based on your exact appetite, family size, and dietary preferences.)*

---

## 1. Produce  
| Item | Approx. Quantity | Notes |
|------|------------------|-------|
| **Leafy Greens** | 2–3 large bags (spinach, kale, mixed salad greens) | 7–10 servings |
| **Cruciferous Veggies** | 1 head broccoli, 1 head cauliflower, 2–3 carrots | 5–7 servings |
| **All‑Season Veggies** | 2 bell peppers, 2 cucumbers, 2 tomatoes, 1 zucchini, 1 eggplant | 7–10 servings |
| **Root & Tubers** | 4 medium sweet potatoes, 3 regular potatoes | 4–5 servings |
| **Fruits** | 7 apples, 7 bananas, 1–2 cups berries (fresh or frozen), 1 orange | 7–10 servings |
| **Avocado** | 3–4 | 3–4 servings |
| **Onions & Garlic** | 2 onions, 1 bulb garlic | 5–7 servings |
| **Herbs** | Fresh basil, cilantro, parsley | 1 bunch each |
| **Lemon/Lime** | 3–4 | For dressings & flavor |
